Element.attribute: This capability describes the processes to design, prepare and conduct IT based tests. On any test project the kinds of work products produced and the process to produce those work products is largely the same. Differences between test projects lie in what is being tested and the objective of the test. The activities, tasks and work products defined in this capability describe a core process that can be applied to any IT test project. Guidance for these differences are supplied in definitions for test levels and test types and provide enough context for method practioners to understand how to apply the content in the test method to their unique test project.

Design Tests
Element.attribute: In this activity, how test are performed are defined at granular level. Effective test design typically requires knowledge of the target solution, knowledge of the functionality under test, and test techniques employed. An efficient test design does not include redundant test scripts.

Element.Name: Prepare for Testing
Element.attribute: Performing this activity instills a level of confidence to proceed with test execution. This activity helps uncover unexpected dependencies or unforeseen issues in the test environment, which can negatively impact test execution.

Element.Name: Conduct Testing
Element.attribute: Execute tests using a previously defined schedule.
